The '''Karsten's World system''' was a part of the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Pygorix system/Legends|Pygorix system]], and access to it was restricted to the [[high abbot]]s of the wealthy celestial body [[Pygorix]], which served as an old religious retreat.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Karsten's World [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
